summary: The Fairbanks court opened five criminal cases on Monday, Nov. 23. The most serious is a second-degree assault charge against a Fairbanks man over an incident the court record dates to Aug. 23, three months before the charge was filed. Charges were also filed during Monday in four cases opened over the weekend that had been recorded with no charging document, among them two cases that answer incidents troopers reported without naming anyone: a traffic stop on the Johansen Expressway and a disturbance at a Fairbanks hotel. The court's weekly charges report covers Nov. 16 to Nov. 22 and lists 39 criminal cases filed at Fairbanks and none at Nenana, Healy or Delta Junction; the cases opened on Nov. 23 fall outside that window and are not in its counts.

entries.title: Second-degree assault charge: Roger L. Bouling
body: Roger L. Bouling is charged with assault in the second degree - causing injury with a dangerous instrument, intentionally - a Class B felony, punishable by up to 10 years. A second count charges assault when a child is present, a Class A misdemeanor. Both counts are recorded by the court as domestic violence related.

Fairbanks; the court record gives the date of the offense as Aug. 23. Case 4FA-26-02339CR, filed Nov. 23. He was arraigned the same day and the Public Defender Agency was appointed to represent him. Preliminary hearings are set for Dec. 3 and Dec. 10 before Judge Brent E. Bennett.
Nothing beyond the court record is reported here.

entries.title: Disorderly conduct charge: Bertha Rose Morry
body: Bertha Rose Morry is charged with disorderly conduct - creating a hazardous condition - a Class B misdemeanor. Best Western on TVSA Way, Fairbanks, Nov. 23 at about 5 a.m.; Alaska State Troopers. Case 4FA-26-02335CR; arraignment Dec. 1 before Judge Maria P. Bahr.

Troopers say they responded to a disturbance call at the hotel, that Morry was intoxicated and disorderly and had assaulted a hotel security guard, and that she was arrested and taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center. The charge the State filed carries no assault count.

entries.title: Fourth-degree assault charge: Ishi Santana Sarten
body: Ishi Santana Sarten is charged with assault in the fourth degree - causing another person to fear injury - a Class A misdemeanor. The court records the count as not domestic violence related.

Fairbanks, offense date Nov. 23. Case 4FA-26-02338CR, filed and arraigned the same day, with the Public Defender Agency appointed to represent him. A pre-trial conference is set for Jan. 7, 2027 and a trial week for Jan. 19, 2027 before Judge Ben A. Seekins.

entries.title: DUI arrest: Hunter James Hughes
body: Hunter James Hughes is charged with driving under the influence of alcohol or a controlled substance and with driving while his license was canceled, revoked or suspended for a criminal offense, both Class A misdemeanors. Two further counts charge a minor operating a vehicle after consuming alcohol, which the court records as non-criminal, and improper use of registration, title or plates. Johansen Expressway just west of College Road, Fairbanks, Nov. 22 at about 1:40 a.m.; Alaska State Troopers. Case 4FA-26-02326CR; arraignment Nov. 27 before Judge Ben A. Seekins.

Troopers say they saw two vehicles stopped on the shoulder, the front one with a license plate hanging off it that did not belong to that vehicle; that one driver and all five passengers were under the influence of alcohol; and that the driver was taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center. They say four of the five passengers were issued citations for minor consuming alcohol. The trooper report names no one and is matched to this case by charge, date and place.

entries.title: Harassment and escape charges: Twyanna Titea Coger
body: Twyanna Titea Coger is charged with harassment in the first degree - offensive contact with bodily fluids - and with escape in the fourth degree, removing oneself from police restraint, both Class A misdemeanors. Best Western Hotel, Fairbanks, offense date Nov. 22; Alaska State Troopers. Case 4FA-26-02327CR; arraignment Nov. 27 before Judge Maria P. Bahr.

Troopers say they responded to a disturbance at the hotel involving an intoxicated woman who is alleged to have set off a fire alarm without authorization, that she ran from troopers and was detained, that she later spat saliva at a trooper, and that while she was being taken to Fairbanks Memorial Hospital she removed a hand from her handcuffs. The trooper report names no one and is matched to this case by charge, date and place. Troopers also listed a criminal mischief charge; no such count appears on the court file.

entries.title: DUI arrest: Caryn Conwell Fuzzard
body: Caryn Conwell Fuzzard, 66, of Homer, is charged with driving under the influence and with refusal to submit to a chemical test, both Class A misdemeanors. Area of McGrath Road, Fairbanks, Nov. 22 at about 2:39 p.m.; Alaska State Troopers. Case 4FA-26-02336CR; arraignment Nov. 27 before Judge Maria P. Bahr.
Troopers say they responded to a report of a single vehicle in the ditch and found the driver to be under the influence, and that she was taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center.

entries.title: Trespass arrest: Shane Trevor O'Brien
body: Shane Trevor O'Brien, 39, was arrested on a charge of criminal trespass in the second degree - entering or remaining unlawfully on premises - recorded by police as a misdemeanor. 3200 block of Adams Drive, Fairbanks, Nov. 22 at 7:59 p.m.; Fairbanks Police.

Police case 26003545; court case 4FA-26-02337CR, opened Nov. 23. The court file records a charging document as pending or not filed, so no charge class is stated on it. Arraignment Nov. 27 before Judge Ben A. Seekins.

entries.title: DUI arrest: Shannon Paul Rice
body: Shannon Paul Rice is charged with driving under the influence with a blood alcohol level of .08 or more, a Class A misdemeanor. Near Cushman Street, Fairbanks, Nov. 21; Alaska State Troopers. Case 4FA-26-02324CR; arraignment Nov. 27 before Judge Matthew C. Christian.

Troopers say they stopped a Ford F-250 after seeing a non-functioning license plate light, that Rice admitted to recently consuming alcohol and showed signs of impairment, and that a breath test at the Fairbanks trooper post recorded a breath alcohol concentration of 0.085. Rice was taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center.

entries.title: Trespass arrest: Mona Jean Lawrence-Pailing
body: Mona Jean Lawrence-Pailing, 55, is charged with criminal trespass in the first degree - entering or remaining unlawfully in a dwelling - a Class A misdemeanor, and with criminal mischief in the fifth degree, damaging property worth less than $250, a Class B misdemeanor. 100 block of Rosella Avenue, Fairbanks, Nov. 22 at 1 a.m.; Fairbanks Police.
Police case 26003540; court case 4FA-26-02325CR. The two counts the court filed are the two offenses police recorded, in the same degrees. Arraignment Nov. 27 before Judge Maria P. Bahr.

entries.title: Felony assault charge dismissed: Jerald Curtis Waters
body: A charge of assault in the third degree against Jerald Curtis Waters was dismissed by prosecutors on Nov. 17, the day after the case was opened at Fairbanks. The single count alleged placing another person in fear of imminent injury with a weapon. The offense date was Nov. 16 at Fairbanks.
Case 4FA-26-02301CR. The court record states the dismissal was by the prosecution and gives no further reason.
